name: Haa? Temee no Doutei xxx de Netorareru Wakeneshi! ~Kasshoku Bakunyuu Gyaru wa Aniki no Onna~
original_name: ハァ？テメェの童貞×××で寝取られるわけねーし！～褐色爆乳ギャルは兄貴のオンナ～
source:
One day, Kotarou was fired from his job. He thought it would be a good idea to get a day job to make ends meet, but then he gets a call from his father and decides to work for the construction company that his family runs.

The next day, his father took him to greet the craftsmen on the job site, and he noticed a female craftsman with big tits among them. He looked closely at her face - it was his younger sister, Konoka.

"It's been a long time, you little-”

"Don't talk to me so casually. If you tell that we are siblings, you will get your balls crushed."

Konoka seemed to have adjusted well to the all-male environment. The most important thing to remember is that you can't get away with anything without a little help from your sister.

translation:
某天，Kotarou被公司解雇了。他本打算找些日结工作维持生计，却接到父亲的电话，于是决定回家里经营的建筑公司上班。

第二天，父亲带他去向工地上的师傅们打招呼。他注意到，其中竟有一位胸部丰满的女工。仔细一看，那正是自己的妹妹Konoka。

“好久不见啊，你这小——”

“少跟我套近乎。敢说我们是兄妹，我就捏爆你的蛋蛋。”

Konoka似乎已经很好地适应了这个全是男人的工作环境。而最重要的一点是，没有妹妹帮忙，什么事都别想办成。
